plan: Given my value of $31, I aim to maximize profit by bidding close to but not exceeding my value to avoid overpaying. I will bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win. I will bid $30, as it is likely to be competitive and ensures a profit margin if I win and pay a lower third-highest bid. This strategy balances the risk of losing with the potential for a positive net gain.

Given my private value of $6, my strategy is to bid conservatively to avoid overpaying relative to the potential gain. Since the value is relatively low, I will bid slightly above half of my value to increase my chances of winning without risking too much of my endowment. This minimizes loss if I win and maximizes profit potential.

Given my private value for this item is $0, my optimal strategy is to not bid at all. Bidding any amount would result in a guaranteed loss, as I would pay the third-highest bid without gaining any value from the prize. Therefore, to maximize my profit, I should bid $0 and preserve my entire endowment.
